description: Returns the unsigned transactions to open a loan: an approval (only if needed) then openLoan. Includes the quote and warnings. The user's wallet must sign and send each step in order.

asset.description: Token contract address on Base (preferred) or its symbol, e.g. WETH, VIRTUAL, esALB

borrower.description: Wallet that will sign; used to skip unneeded approvals and check balances

collateral_amount.description: Collateral to offer, in token units, e.g. 0.5. It is a maximum: only what the loan needs is taken

loan_amount_usdc.description: Loan amount before the fee, in USDC. Omit to borrow the most the collateral allows

max_shortfall_bps.description: Max gap between requested and funded amount in basis points. Omit for the protocol default.

term.description: Loan term: short, medium or long (or 0/1/2). Durations and costs come from get_protocol_info.

name: build_borrow
title: Prepare a loan
